work.text: The most important work about Kyōsai's art and life was written by himself: Kyōsai Gadan (暁斎画談, Kyōsai's Treatise on Painting), half autobiography and half painting manual.
the references to the life of [Kyōsai] in these pages have been taken from the “[Kyōsai] Gwaden” an illustrated autobiographical work issued by the painter in 1887.

source.author: Josiah Conder

work.lead: Conder built his biography of his teacher on it:

moment.text: On starting his own academy, [Kyōsai] attached paramount importance to [studies] and copies from Nature. The grounds round his studio were stocked with all kinds of living creatures which his pupils were set to draw from. In the Gwa-den he gives an amusing sketch of the students at work on different living objects, and introduces the comic element in the form of a monkey playing gymnastics
